using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests;

public class ClusterConfigTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoCollisionDifferentEpochs_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("sender-node", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 123, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SenderNodeIdLessOrEqualLocal_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-2", "192.168.1.1", 7001, 100, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "local-host");
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-1", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 100, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_EpochCollisionWithLogger_LogsWarningAndReturnsBumpedConfig()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>().Object;
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-1", "192.168.1.1", 7001, 100, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "local-host");
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-2", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 100, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        // Verify that the local worker's config epoch was bumped
        Assert.Equal(101, result.workers[ClusterConfig.LOCAL_WORKER_ID].ConfigEpoch);
        // Verify warning was logged (Moq would verify specific LogWarning call if we used Verify, but since it's extension method, we test the behavior)
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_EpochCollisionNoLogger_StillBumpsConfigEpoch()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-1", "192.168.1.1", 7001, 100, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "local-host");
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-2", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 100, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        Assert.Equal(101, result.workers[ClusterConfig.LOCAL_WORKER_ID].ConfigEpoch);
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Reflection;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests;

public class ClusterConfigTests
{
    private static readonly MethodInfo HandleConfigEpochCollisionMethod = 
        typeof(ClusterConfig).GetMethod("HandleConfigEpochCollision", 
            BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoCollisionDifferentEpochs_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        var result = (ClusterConfig)HandleConfigEpochCollisionMethod!
            .Invoke(config, new object[] { senderConfig, mockLogger.Object })!;

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
        mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SenderNodeIdLessOrEqualLocal_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var initMethod = typeof(ClusterConfig).GetMethod("InitializeLocalWorker", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
        config = (ClusterConfig)initMethod!.Invoke(config, new object[] { "local-node-2", "192.168.1.1", 7001, 100L, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "local-host" })!;
        
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = (ClusterConfig)initMethod!.Invoke(senderConfig, new object[] { "local-node-1", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 100L, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host" })!;
        
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        var result = (ClusterConfig)HandleConfigEpochCollisionMethod!
            .Invoke(config, new object[] { senderConfig, mockLogger.Object })!;

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
        mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_EpochCollisionWithLogger_LogsWarningAndReturnsBumpedConfig()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var initMethod = typeof(ClusterConfig).GetMethod("InitializeLocalWorker", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
        config = (ClusterConfig)initMethod!.Invoke(config, new object[] { "local-node-1", "192.168.1.1", 7001, 100L, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "local-host" })!;
        
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = (ClusterConfig)initMethod!.Invoke(senderConfig, new object[] { "local-node-2", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 100L, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host" })!;

        // Act
        var result = (ClusterConfig)HandleConfigEpochCollisionMethod!
            .Invoke(config, new object[] { senderConfig, mockLogger.Object })!;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                    (v?.ToString() ?? "").Contains("Epoch Collision 100 <> 100") &&
                    (v?.ToString() ?? "").Contains("local-node-1") &&
                    (v?.ToString() ?? "").Contains("local-node-2")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_EpochCollisionNoLogger_StillBumpsConfigEpoch()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var initMethod = typeof(ClusterConfig).GetMethod("InitializeLocalWorker", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
        config = (ClusterConfig)initMethod!.Invoke(config, new object[] { "local-node-1", "192.168.1.1", 7001, 100L, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "local-host" })!;
        
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = (ClusterConfig)initMethod!.Invoke(senderConfig, new object[] { "local-node-2", "192.168.1.2", 7002, 100L, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "sender-host" })!;

        // Act
        var result = (ClusterConfig)HandleConfigEpochCollisionMethod!
            .Invoke(config, new object[] { senderConfig, null })!;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        // Verify config epoch was bumped by checking the behavior (can't access private fields directly)
        var configType = typeof(ClusterConfig);
        var getMaxConfigEpochMethod = configType.GetMethod("GetMaxConfigEpoch", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
        var originalMaxEpoch = (long)getMaxConfigEpochMethod.Invoke(config, null)!;
        var resultMaxEpoch = (long)getMaxConfigEpochMethod.Invoke(result, null)!;
        Assert.Equal(originalMaxEpoch + 1, resultMaxEpoch);
    }
}
